title: Spatial Memory Agent: Experience-Grounded Procedure Memory for Spatial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2608.12743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial intelligence is becoming a foundation for embodied agents, robotic planning, and multimodal assistants. To improve the spatial reasoning ability of VLM agents, existing work has mainly followed two lines. One line uses post-training methods, such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Another line adopts an agentic paradigm in which the model calls external spatial tools, such as depth estimation and 3D reconstruction tools, to gather intermediate spatial evidence. We study a complementary and underexplored route: Can a frozen VLM agent improve its spatial reasoning through \textbf{parameter-update-free self-evolution}, without depending on external expert spatial tools at inference time? We present \textbf{Spatial Memory Agent (SMA)}, an \textbf{experience-grounded runtime framework} that converts verified spatial experience into reusable transferable lessons. translated_title: 空间记忆智能体：基于经验沉淀的程序性记忆用于空间智能
translated_abstract: 空间智能正成为具身智能体、机器人规划和多模态助手的基础。为了提升视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体的空间推理能力，现有工作主要沿两条路线展开。一条路线采用后训练方法，如监督微调和强化学习。另一条路线采用智能体范式，即模型调用外部空间工具（如深度估计和3D重建工具）来收集中间空间证据。我们研究了一条互补且未被充分探索的路径：冻结的VLM智能体能否通过**无参数更新的自我进化**来提升其空间推理能力，而无需在推理时依赖外部专家空间工具？我们提出了**空间记忆智能体（SMA）**，一个**基于经验沉淀的运行时框架**，将验证过的空间经验转化为可复用、可迁移的教训。在可验证的空间环境中，SMA查询冻结的VLM智能体，并通过自我进化机制积累程序性记忆，从而在不更新参数的情况下持续改进空间推理性能。
tldr: 本文提出空间记忆智能体（SMA），一个无需参数更新或外部空间工具即可让冻结的VLM智能体通过积累和复用经验教训实现空间推理自我进化的运行时框架。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Spatial Memory Agent (SMA), a runtime framework that enables frozen VLM agents to self-evolve spatial reasoning by accumulating and reusing experience-grounded lessons, without parameter updates or external spatial tools.
